text:
Greetings dear colleagues,
Settled period behind us, one thing is left: handover calls

As we wrap up the settled period, the Companion Animal Travel Desk wants to keep the handover flow smooth and friendly for every case that is still in motion. Please keep sharing clear notes on passenger plans, animal needs, and anything that may affect boarding, transfer, or arrival. The senior coordinator is available for any service call that needs a steady decision, and the cabin team will continue to keep a close eye on animals in flight so comfort and safety stay aligned.

When you brief the next agent, keep the tone warm and practical, and include only what the receiving colleague needs to continue the file with confidence. If a traveler has a rabbit on the booking, <<FACT F064>>. For bird cases, <<FACT F083>>. Please place those details with the same care you would use in a live call, since small omissions can create avoidable delays for the traveler and the pet.

Aurelia Skyways appreciates the calm support everyone has shown through the busy stretch, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is grateful for the steady teamwork across the line. If you spot a gap in a handover, fix it early, note it clearly, and pass it on so the next colleague is not left guessing. Thanks for keeping the care plan thoughtful, the wording simple, and the service kind throughout every transfer.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
